summary: Iteration 2 full-stack verification of StudyFlow. Backend: 39 pytest tests written and all passing (task POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE, overlap + after-exam-date guards, partial_pct 25/50/75 persistence and exact progress math, completato/non_completato math, plan/generate quality (38 tasks, no overlaps, daily_hours cap, available_days respected, all dates <= exam_date), plan/replan preserving completato+parziale history, exam-date shrink deleting late tasks, auth isolation for user B on all task endpoints, AI chat tool-calling verified to actually mutate Mongo for clear_day / move_task / mark_task_status + chat auth isolation). Frontend: login, Home TaskRow (circle toggle, partial popover 25/50/75, X non_completato, pencil edit), TaskEditModal full edit + save/delete/cancel, persistence after F5, 'Sono rimasto indietro' replan without page refresh, /piano grouped 38 sessions with in-place edit + partial propagation, /progressi charts, AI Tutor chat with real DB mutation, and 375px mobile layout all verified working.

minor.issue: Deletes ALL future 'pianificato' tasks including today's, so any concurrent request/session silently loses today's planned sessions. Surfaced as flaky test failures when the suite ran in parallel (pytest -n 2). Not user-visible in single-session use, but consider scoping the delete to date > today or warning the user.

actual_minutes is unconditionally overwritten with null when the field is omitted from the payload (frontend never sends it), so any previously stored actual_minutes is wiped. Use $set only for provided fields.

ui_bugs.issue: The round '+' FAB at bottom-right overlaps the 'Progresso di oggi' percentage value on Home at 375px width, hiding the number.
'Elimina' performs an immediate irreversible DELETE with no confirmation dialog (all other destructive actions use AlertDialog).

issues: Data/Ora inizio use native browser <input type=date/time> pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar/time component used elsewhere - inconsistent look and locale-dependent (renders 09/01/2026 MM/DD/YYYY, ambiguous for an Italian-language app).
DialogContent missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby -> React a11y warning logged in console on every open.
Page does not subscribe to the 'studyflow:plan-changed' event (Home and Plan do), so it will show stale numbers if the AI mutates the plan while it is mounted.

action_items: Add a confirmation step before the Elimina action in TaskEditModal.
Fix mobile FAB overlapping the 'Progresso di oggi' percentage at 375px (add bottom padding to the Home container or move the FAB).
PUT /api/tasks/{id}: stop nulling actual_minutes when the field is not supplied.
Optional: replace native date/time inputs in TaskEditModal with the shadcn Calendar/time picker for consistency and IT locale.
Optional: add DialogDescription to TaskEditModal to clear the a11y console warning; subscribe Progressi to studyflow:plan-changed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1127 lines - split into routers (auth, exams, tasks, plan, chat) plus a services/helpers module.

Overlap-detection logic is duplicated 4x (POST /tasks, PATCH /tasks, _dispatch_tutor_tool.move_task, _fallback_plan). Extract a single async _assert_no_overlap(user_id, day, start, dur, exclude_id) helper.
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} returns db.tasks.find_one({'id': task_id}) without user_id in the filter - harmless today because the 404 guard runs first, but it is an easy scoping regression; add user_id.

/api/chat swallows every LLM/tool exception into a generic Italian string, so real tool-dispatch failures are invisible to the client; return a flag or partial actions so the UI can distinguish 'AI down' from 'nothing to do'.
generate_plan/replan/replan_all repeat the same delete->recompute->generate->insert_many block; factor into one function.
seed_data_creation: Created a throwaway signup user TEST_qa_<hex>@example.com (password Test1234!) per run for auth-isolation tests. Temporary demo tasks prefixed TEST_ are created and deleted by each test. Note: some demo tasks now carry QA topics (QA_EDITED_TOPIC / QA_PIANO_EDIT) and partial statuses from UI testing; re-running plan/generate cleans them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives in /app/backend/tests (conftest.py provides demo_client and other_client fixtures). IMPORTANT: run it with -n 0 (serial). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, and under parallelism TestPlan's /plan/generate wipes today's 'pianificato' tasks that TestStatusAndProgress created, producing a false 404 failure. All 39 tests pass serially. AI tool-calling (clear_day, move_task, mark_task_status) is confirmed working end-to-end against the real LLM and mutates Mongo; chat tests take ~40s. Frontend testids: Home rows use prefix 'task-', /piano rows use prefix 'plan-task-' (task-row-{id}, task-toggle-{id}, task-partial-{id}, task-partial-{id}-{25|50|75}, task-notdone-{id}, task-edit-{id}); modal uses task-edit-exam/date/start/dur-{m}/block-{Name}/topic/save/delete/cancel; Home summary is [data-testid=today-summary] and [data-testid=today-progress-pct]. Mobile bottom nav uses nav-item-{home|esami|piano|progressi|profilo} (Tutor AI link has no matching nav-item-tutor testid).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the iteration-2 scope. The single test failure observed initially was an environment artifact: pytest.ini's forced xdist parallelism let /plan/generate (which deletes all future 'pianificato' tasks, today included) run concurrently with the partial-status tests, deleting their fixture task and yielding 'Task non trovato' 404. Re-running serially gives 39/39. A second initial failure ('_id leaked') was a bad assertion in my own test (substring match hit 'user_id'); fixed to inspect dict keys.
